name: Deep Gluteal Syndrome / Piriformis Syndrome
definition: Pain and/or sciatic-nerve symptoms arising from non-discogenic entrapment or irritation within the deep gluteal space.

redFlags.item: Fever, tumour or vascular red flags

core: Deep gluteal provocation tests interpreted in context

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical and exclusionary; overdiagnosis should be avoided.
investigations.MRI: MRI pelvis/lumbar spine or electrodiagnostic testing is selected for atypical or persistent cases.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may assess hip/pelvic bony pathology.

amber: Image-guided injection or surgery is reserved for selected confirmed persistent entrapment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gridhrasi-like symptoms may occur, but lumbar nerve-root disease and other causes must be differentiated.

patientEducation.summary: Pain and/or sciatic-nerve symptoms arising from non-discogenic entrapment or irritation within the deep gluteal space.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
